items.pos: noun, な adjective, する verb

mnemonic.meaning: 共 together + 通 common: shared together.
mnemonic.reading: "KYOU, TSUU!" (きょうつう) Today (今日) we both get two (ツー) of the same.

examples.ja: 二人には共通の趣味がある。
examples.en: The two of them share a hobby.

items.note: 共通点 = something in common. 共通語 = a common language.

mnemonic.meaning: 制 control + 限 limit: controlled limits.
mnemonic.reading: "SAY, GEN!" (せいげん) Say "General, there's a limit."

examples.ja: この道は速度制限が四十キロだ。
examples.en: The speed limit on this road is 40 km/h.

items.note: 年齢制限 = age limit. 時間制限 = time limit.

mnemonic.meaning: 外 outside + 出 go out: going outside.
mnemonic.reading: "GUY, SHOE-TSU!" (がいしゅつ) The guy puts on shoes to go out.

examples.ja: 今日は雨なので外出しなかった。
examples.en: It was raining today, so I didn't go out.

items.note: A bit formal; 出かける is everyday. 外出中 = out of the office.

mnemonic.meaning: MATOMARU: things gather into one round (丸) shape.

examples.ja: やっと話がまとまった。
examples.en: We finally reached an agreement.

items.note: Intransitive partner of まとめる (Level 3). まとまったお金 = a decent sum of money.

mnemonic.meaning: 経 manage + 営 run: managing and running.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY, AY!" (けいえい) Kay runs the shop, okay?

examples.ja: 父は小さな店を経営している。
examples.en: My father runs a small shop.

items.note: For running businesses. 管理 (かんり) is managing things or people.

mnemonic.meaning: 働 = 亻 (person) + 動 (move): a person moving. Work.
mnemonic.reading: HATARAKI: from 働く (to work). (はたらき)

examples.ja: 肝臓の働きについて学んだ。
examples.en: We learned about how the liver works.

items.note: Also "efforts": 彼の働きで成功した (we succeeded thanks to his work).

mnemonic.meaning: 強 strong: make it stronger.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUYO, MERU!" (つよめる) Strong (強い) mail (メール).

examples.ja: 警察は警備を強めた。
examples.en: The police tightened security.

items.note: Transitive (you strengthen it). 強まる = it gets stronger.

mnemonic.meaning: 傾 lean + 向 direction: the direction something leans.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY, KOU!" (けいこう) Kay tends to cough.

examples.ja: 最近、若者が本を読まない傾向がある。
examples.en: Recently, young people tend not to read books.

items.note: 〜傾向がある = there's a tendency to. Formal.

mnemonic.meaning: 幅 has 巾 (cloth): the width of a piece of cloth.
mnemonic.reading: "HABA!" (はば) Harbour width.

examples.ja: この道は幅が狭い。
examples.en: This road is narrow.

items.note: Also range: 値段の幅 (price range). 幅広い = wide-ranging.

mnemonic.meaning: 微 faint + 笑 smile: a faint smile.
mnemonic.reading: "HOHO, EMU!" (ほほえむ) "Ho ho," and you smile. Note the special reading.

examples.ja: 彼女は優しく微笑んだ。
examples.en: She smiled gently.

items.note: A quiet smile, not a laugh (笑う). 微笑み = a smile.

mnemonic.meaning: 悪 evil + 魔 demon: an evil demon.
mnemonic.reading: "AH, KUMA!" (あくま) Ah, a bear (熊) devil.

examples.ja: 彼は悪魔のような笑顔を見せた。
examples.en: He gave a devilish grin.

items.note: 天使 (てんし) = angel is the opposite.

mnemonic.meaning: 携 carry + 帯 wear: something you carry and wear. A mobile phone.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY, TIE!" (けいたい) Kay ties her phone to her belt.

examples.ja: 携帯を家に忘れてきた。
examples.en: I left my phone at home.

items.note: Short for 携帯電話. Also "carrying": 携帯用 (portable). Many people now say スマホ.

mnemonic.meaning: 脇 has 月 (body part): the side of the body.
mnemonic.reading: "WAKI!" (わき) Wacky armpit.

examples.ja: 本を脇に抱えて歩いた。
examples.en: I walked with a book under my arm.

items.note: Also "beside": 道の脇 (the side of the road). 脇役 = supporting role.

mnemonic.meaning: 銃 has 金 (metal): a metal weapon.
mnemonic.reading: "JUU!" (じゅう) Ten (十) shots from the gun.

examples.ja: 日本では銃を持つことは法律で禁止されている。
examples.en: Owning a gun is illegal in Japan.

items.note: 拳銃 (けんじゅう) = handgun.

mnemonic.meaning: 盾 looks like a shield held over the eye (目).
mnemonic.reading: "TATE!" (たて) A tall shield, standing upright (縦).

examples.ja: 兵士は盾で身を守った。
examples.en: The soldier protected himself with a shield.

items.note: Figurative: 〜を盾にする = to use something as a shield.

mnemonic.meaning: 可 possible + 愛 love: lovable.
mnemonic.reading: KAWAII + RASHII: cute-like. (かわいらしい)

examples.ja: 可愛らしい人形が飾ってある。
examples.en: A lovely doll is on display.

items.note: Softer and more descriptive than かわいい.

mnemonic.meaning: 翼 has 羽 (feathers) on top: wings.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUBASA!" (つばさ) A famous anime and band name. Wings to fly.

examples.ja: 鳥が大きな翼を広げた。
examples.en: The bird spread its large wings.

items.note: Also airplane wings. 羽 (はね) is a feather or small wing.

mnemonic.meaning: 途 way + 端 edge: right at the edge of an action.
mnemonic.reading: "TOE, TAN!" (とたん) The moment your toe touches, tan it.

examples.ja: 家を出た途端、雨が降り出した。
examples.en: The moment I left the house, it started raining.

items.note: Used as V-た + 途端(に). The second event is unexpected.

mnemonic.meaning: 問 = 門 (gate) + 口 (mouth): asking at the gate.
mnemonic.reading: "TOY!" (とい) A toy question.

examples.ja: 次の問いに答えなさい。
examples.en: Answer the following question.

items.note: Formal / written; 質問 is everyday. Common on exam papers.

mnemonic.meaning: 駆 has 馬 (horse): running like a horse.
mnemonic.reading: "KA-KE-RU!" (かける) Same sound as 賭ける and 掛ける. A horse runs.

examples.ja: 子供たちが公園を駆けていった。
examples.en: The children ran off through the park.

items.note: Literary; 走る is everyday. 駆けつける = rush over.

mnemonic.meaning: SUNAWACHI: "SOON, I WATCH": that is to say...

examples.ja: 日本の首都、すなわち東京は大きい。
examples.en: The capital of Japan, namely Tokyo, is big.

items.note: Formal and written. つまり is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 歓 joy + 声 voice: a joyful voice.
mnemonic.reading: "KAN, SAY!" (かんせい) Can you say "Hurray!"?

examples.ja: ゴールが決まると、歓声が上がった。
examples.en: When the goal went in, a cheer went up.

items.note: 歓声を上げる = to cheer.

mnemonic.meaning: 時 time + 刻 moment: an exact moment in time.
mnemonic.reading: "JEE, KOKU!" (じこく) Gee, the clock (コク) says it's time.

examples.ja: 電車の時刻を調べた。
examples.en: I checked the train times.

items.note: A specific point in time. 時間 is an amount of time. 時刻表 = timetable.

mnemonic.meaning: 霧 has 雨 (rain) on top: weather like fine rain in the air.
mnemonic.reading: "KEERI!" (きり) Kiri fog creeps in.

examples.ja: 朝は霧で何も見えなかった。
examples.en: I couldn't see anything in the morning fog.

items.note: 霧が出る = fog comes up. 霧雨 = drizzle.

mnemonic.meaning: 表 express + 示 show: show it on the surface.
mnemonic.reading: "HYOU, JEE!" (ひょうじ) The screen shows a leopard.

examples.ja: 画面にエラーが表示された。
examples.en: An error appeared on the screen.

items.note: Also on labels: 値段の表示 (price label).

mnemonic.meaning: 嵐 = 山 (mountain) + 風 (wind): wind roaring over mountains.
mnemonic.reading: "ARASHI!" (あらし) Also a famous Japanese pop group.

examples.ja: 昨夜はひどい嵐だった。
examples.en: Last night there was a terrible storm.

items.note: Figurative: 拍手の嵐 (storm of applause).

mnemonic.meaning: 拘 seize + 束 bind: seize and tie up.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, SOKU!" (こうそく) Same sound as 高速 (high speed): bound at high speed.

examples.ja: 容疑者は警察に拘束された。
examples.en: The suspect was detained by the police.

items.note: Also "tie down" by work: 拘束時間 (hours you're bound to work).

mnemonic.meaning: 髪 hair + 毛 hair/fur: hair from your head.
mnemonic.reading: "KAMI NO KE!" (かみのけ) KAMI (hair) + KE (fur).

examples.ja: 髪の毛が長くなった。
examples.en: My hair has gotten long.

items.note: Same as 髪 but more everyday; also for a single strand.

mnemonic.meaning: 故 old + 郷 village: your old village.
mnemonic.reading: "KO, KYOU!" (こきょう) Kids from Kyoto return to their hometown. Also read ふるさと.

examples.ja: 夏休みに故郷に帰った。
examples.en: I went back to my hometown for the summer holidays.

items.note: ふるさと is softer and more poetic. 地元 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 裸 = 衤 (clothing) + 果 (fruit): fruit with its skin stripped off.
mnemonic.reading: "HADAKA!" (はだか) Skin (肌, はだ) showing: naked.

examples.ja: 子供が裸で走り回っている。
examples.en: A child is running around naked.

items.note: 裸足 (はだし) = barefoot.
